create_codegen_tokenizer: create a CodeGenTokenizer instance with custom vocab and merges for byte-level BPE tokenization
build_tokenizer_from_pretrained: build a CodeGenTokenizer from pretrained model checkpoint like Salesforce/codegen-350M-mono
test_tokenizer_encode: test encoding text into token IDs with CodeGenTokenizer handling space-sensitive tokenization
run_tokenizer_decode: run decoding of token IDs back to text with CodeGenTokenizer including skip_special_tokens
test_tokenizer_roundtrip: test CodeGenTokenizer encode-decode roundtrip consistency with expected tokens and IDs
